title: Wrong off the bat
body: Wrong off the bat first time I tried it. Wrong plane, wrong takeoff and landing time, wrong seat - showed lay flat in first. Waste of time. Glad I didn’t pay for the app. Only got to track one flight free and totally wrong information

title: Very useful
body: I love to be comfortable on long flights and I always get at least business class. I had soo many bad experiences on some airlines where the aircraft has narrow cabin and business class seats don’t have so much space. It’s hard to determine aircraft when booking flight on regular booking sites. For same price you get great or not even decent seat. This app really helps me decide which flight to book 🥰
